title: Cultural Tradeskills: Halfling
wikitext:
{{Epics Era}}

Can make Vale Leather Armor (tailored with smithing components). Use a [[Forge|Vale Forge]] for the smithing. Use a [[Vale Sewing Kit]] for the tailoring.

== Tailoring ==

There are two sets: "vale studded leather" and "vale reinforced leather". Both sets can be imbued for additional stats with an added deity restriction (Karana). 

Imbued sets are the [[Imbued Vale Studded Armor Set]] and [[Imbued Vale Reinforced Armor Set]]. Both sets require [[Imbued Plains Pebble | Imbued Plains Pebbles]] to create.
